notes.title: Spooked Agent - Halloween Update (v1.0.5)
notes.content:
Don't get spooked Secret Agent, for the fall has reached D.V.S island, and the guards there are preparing for the Halloween event. You might find things a bit different than you expect to. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40814234/44161add5b7a6038bbd8a601f0d77e3ac62c79b9.gif[/img]

From [b]October 1st to November 2nd[/b], the game will change some items to Halloween-themed pickups. And you can expect some leaves to fall in the overworld and some custom levels.

[h3]ːcc_candleːWhat's new[/h3]
• Pickups turned into [b]Halloween-themed candies and items[/b]
• [b]Falling Leaves[/b] weather effect added (in the overworld, and you can enable it in custom levels)
• Few new tiles for level creators
• (FIX) Classic Apogee splash screen will now be shown each February 1st (on the game's birthday)

Have fun 👻

notes.title: Patch v1.0.4.2 - Fixes and new level editor toys
notes.content:
This is a small update to [b]fix some critical issues[/b] as well as some glitches and minor bugs. We are throwing in a few [b]extra level editor toys[/b] to make it more special while we are at it  

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] You can no longer glitch the boss by firing at him while being destroyed
[*] Position of a specific secret bag from the Secret Level in Episode 4 was changed so you can collect it without using the pause glitch.
[*] Pause is now applied to bubbles and boss-level turret
[*] Some minor visual glitches and tiles fixed
[*] Damaging spider will play damage sound now
[/list]

[b]NEW[/b]
[list]
[*] New bonus pickup - [b]Case Folder[/b] 
[*] Few extra map tiles to play with, check them out!
[/list]

If you haven't played Secret Agent HD for a while, you should check out custom levels made by talented level creators. There are over 120 custom levels made waiting for you!

Thanks to a group of individuals for reporting issues ([i]you know who you are[/i]) and everyone else for supporting the game by playing and creating levels. You are the best!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - Christmas edition
notes.content:
December is here and winter caught Agent 006 ½ as well. But nothing stops special agent, especially when you can grab a hot cocoa and a Christmas present along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40814234/bda6ab7b2dbd431a21a0ca0aada49556eef335d1.gif[/img]
[h2]ːGiftedː NEW[/h2]
[list]
[*] Christmas holidays themed pickups lasting through the whole December ([i]festive content can be disabled from settings[/i])
[*] Weather system added to the level editor - Snow
[*] New level editor toys to play with:
  • 2 New Secret objects - [b]Slamming Stone[/b] & [b]Bubbles[/b] from the Secret Level. But in order to use these, you will have to finish the secret level first ([i]if you already did, just load the game[/i])
  • New object - [b]Switch[/b] (toggle moving platforms and water heaters)
  • New object - [b]Water Heater[/b] (melt ice / freeze water by placing heater next to it)
  • New object - [b]Breakable platforms[/b]
  • New object - [b]Enemy Sensors[/b] (shows enemy locations below the sensor on the screen)
  • New object - [b]Yellow Doors[/b]
  • New pickup- [b]Yellow Key[/b] 
  • New pickup- [b]Blue Spy Glasses[/b] (reveals blue hidden platforms)
  • 2 New Level backgrounds  - [b]Mountains[/b] (night) and [b]Cityscape[/b] (day)
  • New background - [b]Big Red Bricks[/b]
  • New Tiles - Slippery ice, snow, palm tree, vines, green blocks, yellow & green platforms and more!
  • You can now place 10 keys of each color
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy the new gifts and we can't wait to see what you'll be making this December! 

[h2]ːcc_crystalː FIXES & UPDATES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ceiling Crawler collision decreased so it can't hurt you from diagonal empty space
[*] Some text issues fixed
[*] Boss bug fixed where you could hit it with the turret while in the death animation which prevented you from finishing the level
[*] E1L05 - Missing ammo pickup added
[*] Episode 3 ending scene issue fixed where flying clouds were seen out of gameplay screen on widescreen resolutions
[/list]

Have a holly jolly December! ːsnowflakesː

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you're having fun with the game! 

We are keeping a close eye on your comments, bug reports & streams so we can fix and improve something as soon as possible so thank you for all the reports and keep them coming! 

You can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1607670/discussions/1/3047230768358006151/]keep a track of all updates including the silent ones here on the forum[/url].

[b]v1.0.3[/b]
[list]
[*][FIX] You could skip 50% of the E4L09 by ignoring the first red door and just go for the 2nd red doors. Second red doors are now green.
[*][FIX] Key Master achievement description mismatch (you need 6 keys, not 4)
[*][FIX] Master Spy achievement won't fail anymore. If it failed for you before, just start the game and it should be awarded.

[*][UPDATE] New background tiles for light beams to light up the sky.
[/list]


[b]v1.0.2.1 Silent update[/b]
[list]
[*] [FIX]Doors hit from below won't always open
[*] [FIX]Game issues when playing on lower resolutions
[/list]

If you have anything to report, please open a topic in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1607670/discussions/0/]Bug Reports forum[/url]. You can also visit the [url=https://discord.gg/apogee]Apogee Entertainment Discord[/url] and let us know there.

Thank you for playing and stay around, there is more to come! ːCotcHeartː
